lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，挪动笨重身躯。
咕噜咕噜，踏过泥泞地面。
笨重的四肢推动着前进。
我用短腿撑着，一摆一摆地走。
lines.en: I prop on short legs and waddle along.

lines.zh: 身体扭一下，往前挪半米。
lines.en: I twist my body and shift half a meter forward.

lines.zh: 蹼足陷进软泥里，拔出来。
lines.en: My webbed feet sink in the mud, then pull free.

lines.zh: 我贴着水边走，省点力气。
lines.en: I keep to the water's edge to save strength.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆两下，身子就前进了。
lines.en: Two sweeps of my tail, and I move forward.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头爬到另一块。
lines.en: I climb from one stone to the next.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，又挪了一小段路。
lines.en: Panting, I shuffle a little farther.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地躺着，盯着天空。
lines.en: Lazily lying, staring at the sky.
Quietly lying in a mud pit.
Lying in the grass basking in the sun.
Sunbathing in warm mud, just right.

lines.zh: 我半泡在水里，只露个头。
lines.en: I sit half in the water with only my head out.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，肚皮贴着暖意。
lines.en: I sprawl on a stone, belly soaking the warmth.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，腮帮一鼓一鼓。
lines.en: I gape for air, throat puffing in and out.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搭在岸边歇着。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the bank.

lines.zh: 我转动眼珠，慢慢看一圈。
lines.en: I roll my eyes and take a slow look around.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬头，喉咙咕噜响。
lines.en: I lift my head from the mud, throat rumbling.

lines.zh: 我从泥里探头，咕噜一声。
lines.en: I poke out of the mud with a gurgle.

lines.zh: 我抬头看一眼，又缩回浅水。
lines.en: One look up, then back into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，猜你要做什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, guessing what you'll do.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我往前挪了一点。
lines.en: You crouch, and I creep a little closer.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，等你喂我。
lines.en: I stare at your hands, waiting to be fed.
You move, and I slide back into the water.

lines.zh: 我从水里探出鼻子，嗅了嗅。
lines.en: I poke my snout out of the water and sniff.

lines.zh: 我半张脸浮着，眼睛先动。
lines.en: Half my face above water, my eyes move first.
I blink, then fix on you again.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，比我有吸引力。
lines.en: The meat in your hand interests me more than you do.
I tilt my head, ear to the water surface.

lines.zh: 我这四条短腿，摔得生疼。
lines.en: These four short legs took the fall.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚皮就往肉上爬。
lines.en: Belly dragging, I crawl straight at the meat.
Come on, give me some food!

lines.zh: 这么多美味，我怎么选呢？
lines.en: So many tasty things, which one to choose?
Meat! Give it here, stop waving it!

lines.zh: 我的小短腿跑不快，等等我！
lines.en: My short legs are slow. Wait for me!

lines.zh: 我咬一口，就认你当主人。
lines.en: One bite, and I'll call you master.
Don't throw it far. I can't swim that fast!

lines.zh: 这味道，比泥里的虫子香。
lines.en: This smells better than mud bugs.

lines.zh: 你蹲着别动，我这就上岸。

lines.en: I just crawled from water onto the mud bank.

lines.zh: 我这四条短腿顶了你一下。
lines.en: My four short legs shove you once.

lines.zh: 我这四条短腿，刚学会爬。
lines.en: These four short legs just learned to crawl.
Watch out for my big jaws!

lines.zh: 我这四条短腿撑不住你。
lines.en: These four stubby legs will not hold you.

lines.zh: 四条短腿，撑起整副骨头。
lines.en: Four stubby legs hold up all these bones.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，用头撞击地面

lines.en: Licks you with its long tongue
Sways its body to search for food
Whips its tail against the ground

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，露出锋利牙齿
lines.en: Opens its wide mouth, revealing sharp teeth

lines.zh: 嗅嗅你的气味，似乎在评估
lines.en: Sniffs your scent, seeming to appraise

lines.zh: 我这四条短腿，已经锁住你了。
lines.en: These four short legs have already locked onto you.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一串咕噜。
lines.en: A string of grunts rolls out of my throat.
Stretches its neck to observe you
Fixes its gaze on you, ready to act
Stretches its limbs, ready for battle

lines.zh: 我的大颚对准你脚踝的软肉。
lines.en: My jaw lines up on the soft of your ankle.
Locks onto prey, ready to hunt
Licks its tongue, ready to attack
Targets you, ready for a killing blow

lines.zh: 用头撞击地面，锁定目标
lines.en: Head-butts the ground, locking onto you
Stretches its body, ready to attack
Guides its attack with its tail
Locks onto you, ready for a fatal strike

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，一口咬下沉重的肉块！
lines.en: Rattle and chomp down a hefty chunk!

lines.zh: 用强壮的牙齿撕裂你的皮肉！
扑向你，溅起满地的血浆！
lines.en: Splat blood as you get lunged at!

lines.zh: 甩动粗壮的身体，重重一击！

lines.en: Claw grabs and bites with force!

lines.zh: 用尖锐的牙齿狠狠咬住你！
嘶嘶叫着，挥舞着沉重的尾巴！
用粗大的尾巴拍击，造成伤害！
lines.en: Slap with big tail for damage!

lines.zh: 咬断你的手臂，鲜血直流！
lines.en: Chomp off arm, let blood flow!

lines.zh: 挥动强壮的四肢，攻击不断！
从地缝中钻出，准备攻击！
在岩缝中苏醒，寻找猎物！
从岩石后探出头，窥视四周！
在地表裂痕中慢慢现身！
从岩堆中缓慢爬出，静候时机！
在黑暗中蠕动，等待时机！
从石头缝隙中缓缓探出！
在岩缝间慢慢探头探脑！
蛋壳破了，我掉进浅水里。
lines.en: The egg splits, and I drop into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我从淤泥里挣出来，甩甩头。
lines.en: I work free of the silt and shake my head.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面，冒出一双眼睛。
lines.en: A pair of eyes breaks the swamp surface.
I've only just hatched, and I'm already hungry.
Burned by fire, struggling to breathe.
